messages:
Anya: quick check-in on playground streaming + prompt library ties. Users hit Stop expecting to tweak prompt then resume. Thinking about a Soft Stop (keeps partial output + prompt draft) vs Hard Stop (discard). Figma: https://fig.ma/file/playground-softstop-v1.
Kai: Soft Stop sounds useful for iterative editing. Suggest UI: after Soft Stop show a compact editor under the message with the prompt prefilled and a small Trim action to remove last token chunk.
Marta: Trim action is neat but be careful with lexical alignment. Maybe show 'Trim last 2 chunks' with a preview before applying. Also add a tiny badge: [Soft-stopped 3 tokens] so users know why resume is different.
Devon: runtime note: we can checkpoint the KV and allow resume only if prompt hasn't changed beyond simple edits. If user edits prompt significantly, resume should be blocked and we show "Cannot resume after major prompt change".
Anya: integration with Prompt Library: allow "Save prompt from stopped response" and "Apply saved prompt to resume". UX question: if user applies a saved prompt, do we treat it as minor edit or new prompt? Probably new.
Kai: token counter placement idea: show tokens in prompt drawer header when a prompt is applied. Also allow a small cost estimate there. Default off for casual users.
Marta: accessibility nits: the Soft Stop chip needs aria-label like "Soft stopped response, 13 tokens buffered. Resume or edit." Keyboard focus order should go: message -> soft stop chip -> inline editor -> resume button.
design-bot: icon guide: Soft Stop = pause icon with dotted outline; Hard Stop = filled square. Trim = scissors icon. Use color to indicate non-destructive vs destructive.
Devon: edge case: if model autoswitch happens between stop and resume, block resume and surface action: "Regenerate with current model" or "Switch back to previous model to resume". Add a tiny hover tooltip explaining KV TTL.
Anya: microcopy candidates for chip: "Soft-stopped 3 tokens (expires 2:59)" and resume button "Resume response". Confirm for hard stop: "Discard response and clear partial output?"
Kai: keyboard shortcuts: 'S' toggles Soft Stop/Resume when focused; 'T' for Trim (opens mini preview); 'P' to open prompt library. Document these in Help and show a small hint on hover.
a11y-bot: checklist: announce soft-stop state changes via aria-live (polite), ensure inline editor is accessible, provide descriptive confirm dialogs for Trim/Hard Stop, expose keyboard shortcuts in Settings, visible focus rings on all chips.
Marta: action items: Anya to add Soft Stop + Trim flows to Figma; Devon to simulate KV checkpoint TTL and blocked-resume messaging; Kai to prototype prompt-drawer token header; I'll draft a11y acceptance tests.
Anya: thanks all  I'll upload updated mocks tonight and tag. :sparkles:
